name: Hepatocyte extension catalog
description: QuPath extension for the hepatocyte-app deep-learning liver H&E segmentation model — import slides and run per-ROI inference from an Extensions → Hepatocyte menu.

extensions.name: QuPath Hepatocyte extension
extensions.description: Runs the sbalci/hepatocyte-app segmentation model on QuPath annotations and imports predictions back as classified polygons with per-class cell counts. Requires a local hepatocyte-app checkout (Python venv + TorchScript model, 🔒 on request); configure paths in Settings.
extensions.author: Serdar Balci
